_comment: The note-type registry (doc 07). A type is one output an engine makes. 'status': ready | coming. Options are the New notes form fields. Never rename an id that has runs. cache_revision is the engine's own cache key, checked against the engine by tests/test_note_types.py.

types.label: Concise hand-drawn notes
types.summary: A lecture PDF becomes hand-drawn concise theory notes (PDF): the same notes the Short Notes app makes.

automation_quality.label: Use sheet automation style and quality checks
automation_quality.hint: Reviews the lecture content and final PDF using the Short Notes automation checks.

instructions.label: Extra instructions for this run
instructions.hint: Optional. Plain commands, e.g. "Keep every reaction condition".

types.label: UPSC daily class notes (DCN)
types.summary: A class recording (+ slides) becomes OnlyIAS daily class notes (Word + PDF) with an error report: the UPSC Notes app's notes.
types.you_get: Word and PDF notes in the PW OnlyIAS DCN layout, and an error report (Excel)

transcript_text_override.label: Existing Drive transcript
transcript_text_override.hint: Optional. Paste the full text from Drive's Transcript panel when the app cannot read it. This skips audio extraction.

lecture_title.label: Lecture title
lecture_title.hint: Optional, e.g. "Probity in Governance, RTI and Citizens Charter".

dmp_no.label: DMP No.
dmp_no.hint: Optional. Printed on the Mains practice sheet.

instructions.hint: Optional. Plain commands, e.g. "Keep every Article number".

types.label: UPSC Mains practice
types.summary: Questions and model answers from finished UPSC notes: the UPSC Notes app's DMP.
types.you_get: A question paper and model answers (Word + PDF)

types.label: DPP from notes
types.summary: A practice set from the question bank that matches finished notes: the UPSC Notes app's DPP (no AI, no cost).
types.you_get: Question paper, solutions and QBG IDs (PDF, CSV, ZIP)

types.label: PW Books handwritten notes
types.summary: A lecture PDF or PowerPoint becomes PW Books handwritten-style notes (Word + PDF): the PW Books app's notes.
types.you_get: <lecture name>_Concise_Notes (Word + PDF) in the PW Books handwritten style

exam.label: Exam
exam.hint: Used for Concise Notes only, as in the PW Books app.

instructions.label: Extra instructions for this lecture
instructions.hint: Optional. Plain commands, e.g. "Keep every SI unit".

types.label: Typeset notes (B.Sc. style)
types.summary: AI notes from your lecture slides, in the fixed B.Sc. Wallah template. Source content and order are retained; every page is checked.
types.you_get: <lecture name> Notes.pdf in the B.Sc. template, source content record and quality report

content_mode.label: Content

choices.reference_ai: AI notes in the B.Sc. template
choices.rewrite: Rewrite into study notes with AI

content_mode.hint: AI reads and checks every page by default, preserving source wording and order in the fixed B.Sc. template.

transcribe_scans.label: Transcribe scanned or complex pages with PW AI
transcribe_scans.hint: Uses PW AI credit and Google sign-in. Reads and verifies each page separately without paraphrasing. Transcription needs source review.

lecture_title.label: Lecture title
lecture_title.hint: Optional. The lecture's own title is used when empty.

figures.label: Labelled figures

choices.6: Up to 6, as in the sample notes

figures.hint: AI rewrite mode only. Preserve mode keeps all original diagrams and never redraws them.

review.label: Check the notes against the lecture
review.hint: AI rewrite mode only. Preserve mode always checks source content and order locally, without rewriting.

instructions.label: Extra instructions for this lecture
instructions.hint: The B.Sc. template stays fixed and source content is retained.

types.label: Google Doc with tabs (B.Sc. style)
types.summary: Final notes in a Google Doc become an editable Google Doc in the B.Sc. template: one tab per source tab, PW logo and watermark. Every word stays the source's; only the design is new, and every tab is checked word for word.
types.you_get: An editable Google Doc in your Google Drive (open it from Runs), and a quality report

share_domain.label: Anyone at PW can edit it (with the link)
share_domain.hint: The Doc is not searchable for the whole company; only people with the link can open it.

types.label: Audio notes (chapter revision podcast)
types.summary: When a chapter is finished, its day-wise lecture notes (PDFs) are joined into one PDF, and two friends revise the whole chapter in an energetic Hinglish conversation: a script you can check and fix, and its audio spoken by PW AI.
types.you_get: <chapter> Audio notes (MP3, about 11 MB for 15 minutes), its script (text file), the merged chapter PDF and a quality report

chapter_title.label: Chapter name
chapter_title.hint: Optional. Used in the file names, e.g. "Electrochemistry". The first lecture's name is used when empty.

teacher_name.label: Teacher name
teacher_name.hint: The friends thank this teacher by name, as the prompt does with "Rahul Sir". Write it as students say it.

length.label: Episode length
length.hint: A longer episode covers more and uses more PW AI credit for the voices.

audio_step.label: When the audio is made
audio_step.hint: Either way the run page shows the script: fix any line there and press Make the audio to speak it again.

host_one.label: First friend
host_one.hint: Opens the talk and asks, like the young man in the team's reference episode.

host_two.label: Second friend
host_two.hint: Explains most of the concepts, like the young woman in the reference episode. Give a name that fits the voice.

instructions.label: Extra instructions for this chapter
instructions.hint: Optional. Plain commands, e.g. "Spend more time on the numericals". The team's prompt itself stays as it is.

tools.label: Check notes
tools.summary: An error report (Excel) for any finished notes file: the UPSC file QC tool. UPSC notes get the full check with PW AI; other notes the basic checks (no AI, no cost).
